name: RBX Analytics Grabber (Internal · Phase 1)
description: Pulls all analytics for an owned Roblox game by universeId — either passively (capturing what the dashboard loads) or actively (replaying the dashboard's own requests in your session, no tab browsing). Saves every grab to the project's data/ folder and forwards it to the Indigo LiveOps web app. Own-data only. No credentials are ever read or stored.
